integrity: Self-contained symbolic proof and a standard-library finite checker included; finite tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite-family claim.
scientific_limitations: For n>=5 only, fully whiskered cycles at matching threshold n-2; no equivariant claim or other matching threshold is covered. Combinatorial Alexander duality plus Hurewicz/Whitehead supplies integral homotopy, with supplementary exhaustive finite tests. Residual risk of implicit prior equivalent literature.
title: A cyclic four-polytope hidden in the near-extremal matching-free complex of a whiskered cycle
